## Why visit

An excellent starting or finishing point for a Macclesfield beer day because it is close to both railway and bus stations. The long-established pub offers a straightforward traditional setting, a winter fire and a clear emphasis on well-kept northern cask. It pairs especially well with RedWillow: one gives you a conventional local free-house experience, the other a modern brewery bar with a wider cider selection. A lunchtime visit can also provide a proper home-cooked meal. This is a useful choice when you want an outing built around beer quality rather than elaborate travel logistics.

## Beer

CAMRA reports up to seven cask beers, generally pale ales from northern breweries.
